jp_verse:
声は消えても

    余韻は静かに残り

    心を満たす
en_verse: Though the sound has faded,\nits resonance lingers quietly,\nfilling the heart.

jp_verse:
知識を越えて

    静けさの奥にある

    真実を見る
en_verse: Beyond mere knowledge,\ntruth is found quietly resting\nwithin stillness.

jp_verse:
映るものより

    曇りなき心こそ

    真を映し出す
en_verse: More than reflection,\nan unclouded heart reveals\nwhat is truly real.

jp_verse:
境を越えて

    なお残るものだけが

    本当の絆
en_verse: Beyond all boundaries,\nonly what still remains\nwas ever real.

jp_verse:
消えたあとに

    静けさだけが残り

    風が名を呼ぶ
en_verse: After all has gone,\nonly silence still remains\nwhile the wind recalls.

jp_verse:
見えぬ者ほど

    深く光を求めて

    真実へ行く
en_verse: Those without eyesight\noften search more deeply still\nfor what truly shines.

jp_verse:
霞む景色に

    心は幻を追い

    道を見失う
en_verse: Within blurred landscapes,\nthe heart chases illusions\nand loses its way.

jp_verse:
荒れた野にも

    かつて誰かの祈りが

    風に残る
en_verse: Even ruined fields\nstill carry forgotten prayers\nwithin the wind.

jp_verse:
遠い光を

    静かに見つめながら

    夜明けを待つ
en_verse: Gazing toward distant light,\nthe heart waits silently\nfor the coming dawn.

jp_verse:
迷う時こそ

    静かな心の声が

    道を示す
en_verse: When lost in darkness,\nthe quiet voice within\nshows the proper way.

jp_verse:
立ち塞がる

    その壁を越えた先に

    新しい空
en_verse: Beyond every wall\nthat rises to obstruct us\nlies another sky.

jp_verse:
駆けてゆく背に

    まだ知らぬ未来だけが

    風と揺れる
en_verse: Upon the young back,\nan unseen future trembles\nwithin the wind.

jp_verse:
花は散っても

    その香りだけはまだ

    時を越えて
en_verse: Though blossoms may fade,\ntheir fragrance continues on\nbeyond passing time.

jp_verse:
満たしすぎた

    その重さの奥にある

    静かな孤独
en_verse: Beneath excessive weight\nrests a quieter burden\nhidden in silence.

jp_verse:
戸を叩けば

    静かな灯の向こうに

    誰かが待つ
en_verse: When knocking softly,\nbeyond the quiet lamplight\nsomeone still awaits.

jp_verse:
手を放せば

    風は遠く空へと

    心を運ぶ
en_verse: Once the hand releases,\nthe wind carries the spirit\ninto distant skies.

jp_verse:
激しい雨も

    過ぎれば静けさだけ

    大地に残る
en_verse: Even violent storms\nleave only quiet behind\nupon the earth.

jp_verse:
古い殻を

    静かに脱ぎ捨てれば

    朝が始まる
en_verse: Casting off old shells,\na quieter self awakens\nwith the morning light.

jp_verse:
語り合えば

    閉ざされた心にも

    灯がともる
en_verse: When words are shared well,\neven guarded hearts begin\nquietly to glow.

jp_verse:
鋭さとは

    傷つける力ではなく

    真を見る目
en_verse: True sharpness is not\nthe power merely to wound,\nbut to see clearly.
